The Authentic Name

Why gilgameš.com is the correct form

Cuneiform

𒄑𒂆𒈦

The name in its original Cuneiform form. 𒄑𒂆𒈦 → Gilgameš. Sumerogram GILGAMESH (𒄑𒂆𒈦) · Standard royal name of the king of Uruk · The final š corresponds to Akkadian /š/

ASCII Constraint

GILGAMESH

Stripped of its identity, the name was reduced to plain Latin letters. The original orthography — stress, length, breathing — was erased by systems that only understand A-Z.

Unicode Restoration

Gilgameš

The Unicode restoration recovers what ASCII destroyed. This is philological accuracy — not decoration. The domain encodes to Punycode, but the browser displays the truth.

Punycode Encoding
gilgameš.com → xn--gilgame-wqb.com

The non-ASCII characters in Gilgameš are encoded while the ASCII remains visible. To the DNS, it is Punycode. To humanity, it is Gilgameš.

Tier Classification

Why Gilgameš is classified as Tier-2 Basic

The Mesopotamian form 𒄑𒂆𒈦 preserves neither stress nor length in this Unicode restoration. This makes it a single-tier Tier-2 Basic name — still a scholarly step above plain ASCII, but without the distinctive phonetic features that define higher tiers.
